The star formation and gas content of satellite galaxies around the Milky Way (MW) and

of star formation in𝑧 = 0 galaxies at𝑀 = 105�10 M  around 14 MW-mass hosts from the

(𝑀 107�8 M ) split roughly equally between quiescent and star-forming. Hosts with more
gas in their circumgalactic medium have a higher quiescent fraction of massive satellites
(𝑀 = 108�9 M ). We ﬁnd no signiﬁcant dependence on isolated versus paired (LG-like)
host environments, and the quiescent fractions of satellites around MW-mass and LMC-mass
hosts from the FIRE-2 simulations are remarkably similar. Environmental eﬀects that lead to
